Atténuation de l’Évasion de l’Hyperviseur

A set of security controls and techniques that prevent or detect attempts by virtual machines to break out of hypervisor containment and gain access to the host or other guest VMs.

Definition

A set of security controls and techniques that prevent or detect attempts by virtual machines to break out of hypervisor containment and gain access to the host or other guest VMs.

Operational example

Enable hypervisor escape mitigation by patching hosts and monitoring for suspicious inter-VM behavior that could indicate containment bypass.
